Face Analysis Research
& Camera Lab

Understand why the same face can produce different measurements. Explore the assumptions, calculations and limits behind the result.

These five studies use synthetic coordinates or a simple camera model. They are original computational experiments, with no human participants or photo-analysis accuracy claims.

Inspect and reproduce the calculations

Every table is calculated from the published inputs using the site's geometry code or the stated pinhole formula. No results are typed in by hand.

Download all inputs and results (JSON) ↓

Run the same experiment yourself

Download these four JavaScript files into one directory, then run node reproduce.mjs with Node.js 22 or newer. The printed JSON contains all five datasets and the assumptions.

  • reproduce.mjs
  • research-experiments.mjs
  • geometry-core.mjs
  • local-overall-analysis.mjs

Read our editorial policy for the difference between measured data, simulation and illustration. These computations test formulas; they do not validate the landmark detector on real people.
